optedOut.description: True to leave the event, false to rejoin (while voting is open).

errors.name: Closed
errors.description: Voting has closed; participation can no longer change.

errors.name: AdminLocked
errors.description: The removal was placed by an operator and cannot be undone by the account.

main.description: Opt the authenticated account out of (or back into) the 38 Most Influential Bluesky Posters of 2026. Requests must carry a service-auth token bound to this method; the account is taken from the token's issuer. An admin-placed removal cannot be undone from here.
